title: Base Encapsulated Interface Transport variant 4
purpose: Reach nested MEI parsing through a Read Device Identification request with a recognized function and MEI type.
expected_behavior: The server should parse function 43, MEI type 0e, read-code 01, and starting object identifier 00, returning device-identification data or a protocol-defined exception.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0005 equals unit identifier plus four-byte PDU
Encapsulated Interface Transport function code 43 is used
Nested MEI type 0e and request fields are present
Unit identifier differs from the other candidates
issue_safety_notes: No external issue knowledge or vulnerability report was supplied or used; nested parser coverage is based on model-prior protocol plausibility and is not externally verified.
